activity_summary: After Two Gentlemen the report was an ordinary house. Margery gave no sum and no alarm. Burbage called it a playing day and left it there. You did not dress it. You went home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to make the house into news, and went home.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Called it a playing day and sent him home.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Gave a flat report and no sum.

facets.activity: Heard an ordinary report and went home

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: An ordinary stair. I have my line, and it is only that.
